title: 午夜来电 · 第一集
what_if: 一个深夜女主播，突然收到她三年前失踪姐姐的直播私信。
target_feeling: 悬疑 + 惊悚 + 反转钩子
visual_style: dark moody live-streaming setup, single warm desk lamp vs cold screen glow, shallow depth, subtle grain

characters.name: 小满
characters.identity_note: female 24, round face, black hair in a loose bun, oversized cream hoodie, soft makeup, tired but alert; do-not-change: face, bun, cream hoodie

scenes.name: 直播房间
scenes.description: small bedroom studio, ring light off, single warm desk lamp, laptop with live camera, dark window behind showing city night
scenes.light_baseline: key: warm desk lamp from left, fill: cold laptop screen, mood: uneasy

shots.continuity_handoff: Open on Xiaoman mid-stream, calm; her phone buzz is the seed for the reveal next shot.
shots.lighting_baseline: key: warm desk lamp left, fill: cold laptop screen
shots.shot_description: Xiaoman talking to camera mid-stream, warm and chatty; her phone lights up on the desk and buzzes.

per_second.action: Xiaoman talks to camera, smiling, gestures
per_second.spatial: Xiaoman center, lamp left, laptop center

per_second.action: phone screen lights up on desk, buzzes
per_second.spatial: phone lower third, Xiaoman behind soft
per_second.audio: phone buzz cuts the room tone

per_second.action: Xiaoman glances at phone, smile freezes

dialogue.text: 家人们，今天的礼物我全收下了啊，谢谢！

references.label: <Picture 1>
references.retention_note: retain face + bun + cream hoodie of Xiaoman
references.description: the young female streamer in the cream hoodie

shots.continuity_handoff: Phone in hand; same room/landmarks; the DM preview lands the twist — sender is her 'dead' sister.
shots.lighting_baseline: key: warm desk lamp left; modifier: phone glow on face, colder
shots.shot_description: Xiaoman brings the phone close; the DM preview shows a name she hasn't seen in three years; her breath catches; end on the name.

per_second.action: Xiaoman brings phone to eye level, thumbs still
phone screen: a DM preview name glows, Xiaoman's pupils dilate
Xiaoman's hand trembles, phone nearly slips
per_second.handoff: end on her horror close-up + sting
